# Gif: GIF images decoded to RGBA
# @weight 2

The images were written by ImageMagick 7, most from one 13 x 7 picture, and
are carried here in hex.  Each case's expected value is the CRC-32 of the
RGBA ImageMagick gives for the file's first image flattened onto a
transparent screen (`magick 'F.gif[0]' -background none -flatten rgba:-`).
The local colour table case is the global one's file with its table moved
onto the image.

## images

### two pixels: the RGBA itself

```x
(do (import x/codec/gif) (import x/codec/bytes) (import x/codec/crc32)
  (def r (Bytes of-hex "47494638396102000100f00100000000ffffff21f90400000000002c0000000002000100000202440a003b"))
  (def d (Gif decode (first r) 0 (List ref 2 r)))
  (list (first d) (List ref 1 d) (Crc32 of (List ref 2 d) 0 (* 4 (* (first d) (List ref 1 d))))))
```
---
    (2 1 1912420358)

### two pixels: black, then white

```x
(do (import x/codec/gif) (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def r (Bytes of-hex "47494638396102000100f00100000000ffffff21f90400000000002c0000000002000100000202440a003b"))
  (Bytes hex (list (List ref 2 (Gif decode (first r) 0 (List ref 2 r))) 0 8)))
```
---
    "000000ffffffffff"


    (13 7)

## malformed images

### not a GIF

```x
(do (import x/codec/gif) (import x/codec/bytes)
  (def r (Bytes of-hex "00494638396102000100f00100000000ffffff21f90400000000002c0000000002000100000202440a003b"))
  (guard (e (e msg)) (Gif decode (first r) 0 (List ref 2 r))))
```
---
    "Gif: not a GIF: the signature does not match"

